description:
Short episodes for Pokémon's 30th anniversary released on the Pokémon Official YouTube Channel.

Episodes:
#1: Kameil to, Natsu no Tsuzuki (カメールと、夏のつづき), released August 12. 2026.
#2: Mischievous Whimsicott? Not on Mabosstiff's Watch! / Itazura Elfuun to Saseruka Mafitiff (いたずらエルフーンとさせるかマフィティフ), released August 19, 2026.
